title: Parallel corpus: English and Spanish prompts

fields.name: text
fields.description: The prompt sentence, 1 to 14 words, no digits or abbreviations (Common Voice sentence rules)

fields.name: topic
fields.description: Everyday theme, e.g. home, school, shop, health, weather, government office

fields.name: origin_ref
fields.description: Id in the origin, e.g. the Tatoeba sentence id; empty for prompts written for the project

fields.name: author
fields.description: Who wrote the prompt: machine for machine drafts, otherwise contributor handles from _meta/contributors.tsv, separated by '; '

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the review-board members who confirmed the row, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed. Never machine.

$comment: PROPOSAL, not in _meta/schema/ yet. For corpus/parallel/prompts.tsv and eval/parallel/prompts.tsv. Prompts are not Aruban text, so no spelling checks and no source/page: origin, origin_ref and author record provenance. The folder decides the split: a prompt in eval/parallel/ is held out and never trained on.
